picks.title: James D. Ryan, "The Upanisads as They Are: Brhadaranyaka, Chandogya, Aitareya, Taittiriya, Kausitaki" (Bloomsbury, 2026)

picks.reason: Scholarly focus on early Upanishads as foundational Hindu texts with diverse teachings.

picks.title: 1821: Krishna Doesn't Need Your Zucchini Bread | But He Wants Your Love
picks.summary: The Bhagavad-gītā sings of Krishna as the Absolute Truth — complete in himself, independent and lacking nothing. He doesn't need anything we can offer him. And yet — he wants our love. Raghunath and Kaustubha explore that paradox through the narration of Krishna's entrance into Mathurā — and what two very different encounters reveal about the one thing that actually matters in our relationship with God. picks.title: S1E15 — Bringing Ganga to Earth | Ramayan – The Eternal Journey
picks.summary: Bhagiratha takes on a sacred mission: to bring the divine river Ganga down to Earth and liberate the sons of Sagara.Through years of intense austerity, Bhagiratha earns the blessings of Brahma and Shiva. But Ganga’s descent is so powerful that only Shiva can receive her safely. From Shiva’s matted locks, the river finally reaches the Earth and follows Bhagiratha toward the ashes of his ancestors.In this episode of Ramayan – The Eternal Journey, discover the devotion, perseverance, and divine intervention behind one of the Ramayan’s most enduring stories — the descent of Ganga.Presented by Drea
